decisions.energy: Prototype 12 max, 2 per first clear, +1 each 15 minutes after a debit, with 1-1 through 1-5 exempt. Device-local clock and Journey save. Accepted run cost is checkpointed. Old saves without Energy start full and old checkpoints keep free completion.
decisions.pacing: Chapter 1 targets in active seconds before boss are 165, 220, 235, 248, 315. Total clear targets are design ranges. Existing boss HP and patterns are retained until device play gives timing evidence.
decisions.ambient: Original compact audio assets and existing scenery, two motifs per authored map, up to six local effects. Crowded mode draws two local accents and suppresses inherited broad mist. Trials use their frozen combat rules.

validation.campaign_energy_ambient_hero: 335/335, all 26 authored maps, real opening pickup, earned pre-boss Qi, both locales, all five slots
validation.actual_victory_atomicity: 15/15, injected write barrier logs expected reward failure; rollback and retry verified
validation.native_x11: 76/76, full scene captures and first native swipes, EN/ID, simulated insets, portrait and landscape; software rendering
validation.regression: Stage Records 91, Journey 27, Home/Boss 84, Combat Clarity 66, Level-Up heal 20, Paid Run Recovery 15, Heavenly Trials 57 and recovery 27, Interface 91, Event Scroll 159, all passing
validation.production_contract: 24/24 combined with paid gameplay. All nine production gates preserved.

opening_pilot.scope: Actual gameplay loop with scripted movement and upgrade selections, damage immunity for the pilot. Different opportunity counts are fixture evidence; full boss kill time and first-time player behavior are pending.
